title: Generic workspace runtime moves to @inventarch/workspace-runtime
summary: Workspace capture and adoption, resources, projections, publication, candidates, templates, lifecycle, authoring manifest, installed catalog, sources, local store and adapters are published as @inventarch/workspace-runtime. It declares @inventarch/authoring-system, whose installed bytes its implementation digest pins, and bounds the walk of each pinned package directory (depth 16, 2,000 entries, 8 MiB per code file, 32 MiB per package), refusing a larger tree with IA-CORPUS-DENIED. @inventarch/agent-composition-system keeps the composition compiler and depends on the new package. Its root re-exports of the moved symbols and every moved subpath, including the 18 ./internal/* subpaths that 1.1.0 published, remain as plain aliases that forward to @inventarch/workspace-runtime; they carry no per-symbol deprecation hint and are removed at the next major.
